theme: Peak-season rides and loss-aversion - airport runs, valley drives and golden-hour shikaras booking all day during the Yatra; an idle cab or boat loses the fare to a listed one
season: Peak summer (9 July 2026). The Amarnath Yatra is underway (3 Jul - 28 Aug), so Pahalgam, Sonamarg and Baltal are busy and fill 3-4 weeks out, while Srinagar and Gulmarg stay comparatively easy. Srinagar is warm by day and cool at dawn (~15-28C); the Gulmarg meadow is lush and cool (~14-17C) with the gondola running; the high pastures are green and the Dal is glass at first light while the plains sit above 40C. Valley travel runs 7am-6pm during the Yatra; brief afternoon showers possible.
campaign_name: Cabs & Shikaras Golden-hour rides booking now [INR] - 09 Jul 2026
subject: The golden-hour shikaras are booking without your boat
